events.region: Treasure; Northern Big Horn; Northeastern Yellowstone; Southwestern Yellowstone
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
Fog has formed along portions of the Yellowstone River from Billings
to Hysham, and the Bighorn River from Hardin northward. Travelers on
I-90 and I-94 in these areas should expect to encounter poor
visibility, locally to a quarter mile or less. With temps below
freezing some roads and sidewalks may be a little icy as well. Use
caution and allow extra time for your morning commute.

Expect fog to dissipate between 9 and 11 am this morning.

events.region: Lyon; Osceola; Sioux; O'Brien; Plymouth; Cherokee; Woodbury; Rock; Dixon; Dakota; McCook; Minnehaha; Hutchinson; Turner; Lincoln; Bon Homme; Yankton; Clay; Union
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
Areas of fog have developed this morning, with dense fog
primarily confined to areas along and near river valleys. Though
fog may spread a bit farther, the greatest chance of dense fog
will continue to be along and near river valleys through the
morning commute Thursday. Make sure to use your low beam
headlights when driving in fog and consider leaving extra time to
get your destination. Any fog should lift entirely between 10 and
11 am.
